independent_artifact_verification.sha256sums_path_note: The archived SHA256SUMS records original GitHub-runner absolute paths. Independent verification rebased each entry to the extracted basename before hashing; all 17 payload hashes matched.

source.license: CC BY-SA 4.0; self-published Wikimedia Commons footage

reference.construction: spatial normalization to 1920x1080 yuv420p only; no temporal fps normalization; exact 180-frame output budget

temporal_findings.ordering: hold beats FFmpeg linear interpolation at 5, 10 and 15 authoritative fps on both PSNR and SSIM against genuine native-60 temporal ground truth

comparison_to_daybreak_normalized_refere.daybreak_reference_class: native ~29.97-fps source normalized to 60 fps with FFmpeg fps=60
comparison_to_daybreak_normalized_refere.native60_reference_class: genuine 60/1 source; no temporal fps normalization
comparison_to_daybreak_normalized_refere.conclusion: The qualitative hold-over-linear ordering is preserved on genuine native-60 footage, so that ordering is not solely an artifact of Daybreak 30-to-60 normalization. Magnitudes are benchmark-class-specific and must not be pooled.

scope_limits: No trained-neural reconstruction quality was measured by this gate.
No RV1126 silicon timing was measured.
No converter success or RKNN export is interpreted as runtime image quality.
Normalized Daybreak and genuine native-60 are distinct benchmark classes and are not merged.
